notes: The three temporal articles all take 'the ... day' under rules 22 and 102, leaving the participle or adjective its own bare word; the analysis is applied uniformly across the verse per rule 24.
κἀκεῖθεν takes both 'And' and 'from thence' as one crasis unit headed on the adverbial (rule 55), so ἀποπλεύσαντες keeps only 'sailing'.
